items.title: Solana Policy Institute CEO says Clarity Act in ‘August recess purgatory,’ gives it 10% odds before midterms
items.whyYouShouldCare: The uncertain fate of the Clarity Act could impact regulatory clarity for Solana, affecting its adoption and ecosystem growth leading into the midterms.

items.title: Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic
items.whyYouShouldCare: Adjustments to slot time and validator economics may enhance Solana's network efficiency, potentially attracting more developers and users to its ecosystem.

items.title: FalconX, Interstice Connect Canton to Ethereum, Solana and Robinhood Chain
items.whyYouShouldCare: The integration of FalconX and Interstice with Ethereum, Solana, and Robinhood Chain could increase liquidity and cross-chain usage, benefiting Solana's market position.
